items.title: Meshy Wants AI for 3D Creation to Feel More Like a Creative Partner
items.excerpt: Rather than treating AI as a one-shot generator, Meshy's new conversational 3D Agent is built to help game artists brainstorm, iterate, and build style-consistent asset families through an ongoing dialogue before exporting production-ready models into existing pipelines. It positions generative 3D as a collaborator for concept exploration and background props while artists keep hero assets, topology, and creative judgment.

items.title: "A couple of companies have managed to ignite a culture war": Games AI veteran says it can be useful, but we've made mountains out of ChatGPT's molehills
items.excerpt: Veteran games-AI researcher Luke Dicken argues the industry's real opportunity is richer, more adaptive player experiences and smarter production tooling -- not replacing human talent -- and that the loudest genAI hype and backlash have both overshot the actual craft. A grounded read on where machine learning genuinely changes how games get designed and balanced.

items.title: New method teaches AI to make 2D designs 3D
items.excerpt: A new AI technique converts flat 2D designs into usable 3D geometry, a workflow shift directly relevant to how game artists could turn concept art into game-ready assets. PC Gamer walks through what the method does and where it could plug into asset-creation pipelines.
